subject: Credential-claim evidence & SCIM delta justification for TrustBridge audit
body_preview: Auditor requests: export of SCIM delta, owner-of-record claims for service credentials, and an attestation note explaining elevated access exceptions.
messages:
From: Samuel Turton <samuel.turton@trustbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: TrustBridge Audit Team <audit@trustbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: owner claims + SCIM delta for SOC2 review (TrustBridge)

Hi Rishi,

We're kicking off the access-control portion of TrustBridge's SOC 2 Type II review. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOD Tuesday (US/PST)?

- SCIM delta file covering 2026-10-25 -> 2026-11-01 (additions/changes/removals). CSV or JSON is fine.
- A per-service-account owner-of-record mapping (who is responsible/approver) and justification for any accounts with owner as a team rather than an individual.
- A short attestation (1 page max) explaining any outstanding privileged-access exceptions in the past 90 days and the mitigation steps taken.

If you have pre-packaged artifacts or a Drive folder, a link will do. We're able to take files via SFTP if easier.

Thanks,
Samuel
On behalf of TrustBridge Audit

Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Turton <samuel.turton@trustbridge.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: owner claims + SCIM delta for SOC2 review (TrustBridge)

Samuel — thanks for the clear ask. We'll put together a minimal evidence bundle and a one-page attestation. Quick clarifications before we start:

1) SCIM delta: do you want the raw change feed from our identity provider (SCIM patch history) or a reconciled CSV that includes current state + delta? We can provide both but the reconciled CSV will include owner ids and role name mappings.

2) Service accounts: Are you focused only on non-human credentials (service accounts / API keys / JWT clients) or should we include automation users that are human-owned but used by CI (e.g., ci-bot@redwood.com)?

3) Attestation: do you need an exec signature (VP/Product or CISO) or is a lead-engineer sign-off acceptable for this phase?

We'll aim to deliver an interim package (SCIM deltas + claims spreadsheet) by EOD Tuesday and a final attestation PDF after internal review. Priyom — can you pull the SCIM delta and reconcile owner_of_record against our entitlement store? Irene — can you draft the attestation template I can circulate for signature?

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta + initial claims (draft)

Saved you some time — I exported the SCIM patch log from our IDaaS for the window you requested and ran a quick reconciliation against the entitlement ledger. Files attached: scim_delta_20261101.csv and service_account_claims_20261108.xlsx. Notes: 

- The CSV includes columns: timestamp, op (create/update/delete), user_id, external_id, displayName, groups_added, groups_removed, raw_patch.
- The claims workbook has a "justification" column where I flagged entries that looked like team-owned credentials or recently rotated keys. 
- There are three service accounts without a single owner-of-record (they're mapped to on-call rotation aliases). I added a recommended owner (individual) and a short rationale.

Ben — I left a sheet with suggested owners that CS/Eng can review. We should decide whether to convert team owners into individual owners for auditability or keep them as documented team responsibilities with an SLA for owner nomination.

Rishi — happy to refine if TrustBridge wants the raw patch payloads instead of my reconciled CSV.

Attachments: scim_delta_20261101.csv (text/csv), service_account_claims_20261108.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Turton <samuel.turton@trustbridge.com>, TrustBridge Audit Team <audit@trustbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Attestation: privileged access exceptions and mitigation (draft)

Samuel / TrustBridge team — attaching a short attestation and a summary of recent privileged-access exceptions. Highlights: 

- Exceptions window: 2026-08-01 -> 2026-11-01 (90 days).
- Total privileged-access exceptions: 4 (two emergency elevation requests, one third-party integration change, one transient RBAC misassignment). Each item is summarized in the attached leastpriv_summary_20261108.pdf with timestamps and remediation steps (revoke/rollback, additional monitoring, owner reassignment).
- Mitigations in place: tighter request gating (JIRA approvals + 2FA confirmation), automated rollback job for incorrect RBAC pushes, and weekly entitlement reconciliations by the security ops team.

Requested sign-off: please confirm if a Lead-Security Engineer signature is sufficient for your current evidence intake or if you require VP/CISO sign-off. I'll prepare both versions.

Attachments: leastpriv_summary_20261108.pdf (application/pdf), saml_assertion_samples.txt (text/plain)
From: Samuel Turton <samuel.turton@trustbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: TrustBridge Audit Team <audit@trustbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credential-claim evidence & SCIM delta justification for TrustBridge audit

Irene / Rishi — this is exactly what we need, thank you. The reconciled CSV + claims workbook are perfect and the one-page attestation covers our ask. Two small follow-ups: 

1) Could you replace the on-call alias entries with a short note on rotation ownership (e.g., "oncall-ops: primary = alice.sheppard, secondary = pagerduty-rotation") rather than a team label? That will make owner-of-record assertions explicit.

2) For the two emergency elevation events, can you attach the associated JIRA tickets or link to the runbook that authorized the elevation? We just need the ticket IDs for traceability.

If you can drop those two small items into the Drive folder you linked, we'll mark this section of the audit as satisfied.

Thanks — Samuel

Attachments: none
